A single white DualSense-style controller sits in front of the console in both photos.
No power cable, HDMI cable, box, or second controller is visible in either photo.
No serial number, model number plate, or region sticker is visible or legible in either photo.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' overlay both images; no power-on screen or boot test is shown.
Surface condition looks clean in the visible areas, but lighting and resolution limit close inspection for scratches or yellowing.
